January 4, 2019 

Denise J. McNerney 
Merits Cases Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States  
One First Street, NE 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re:  No. 17-1606, Smith v. Berryhill 

Dear Ms. McNerney: 

As  the  Court-appointed  amicus  curiae  in  support  of  the  judgment  below,  I  write  to 
request a short extension of the briefing schedule in light of the rescheduling of oral argument 
from  the  February  to  March  sitting.  I  have  conferred  with  counsel  for  the  parties,  both  of 
whom consent to this request.  

The  amicus  brief  in  support  of  the  judgment  below  is  currently  due  on  January  22.  I 
respectfully  request  an  extension  of  that  deadline,  to  and  including  January  30.  The  parties’ 
replies  would  then  be  due  on  March  1,  allowing  sufficient  time  between  the  replies  and  the 
oral argument in March. 

Thanks very much for your attention to this matter. 

Sincerely, 

Deepak Gupta 
Court-Appointed Amicus Curiae  

cc: Counsel for Petitioner and Respondent 

Gupta Wessler PLLC 
1900 L Street, NW, Suite 312, Washington, DC 20036 
P 202 888 1741     F 202 888 7792
